user.title: Adjustable bed for HomeKit
user.description: Publishes your bed, with the controls you selected and named, as one HomeKit accessory in the Home app, so you operate the bed with sliders and switches. Every bed gets its own pairing code.

data_description.name: The name of the bed tile in the Home app.
data_description.bed_device: Optional. Used to find the controls of the bed automatically.
data_description.port: Must differ from the port of every HomeKit Bridge (21063, 21064, …).

entities.title: Controls
entities.description:
## Register controls in HomeKit

The controls of this device cannot be detected automatically. Link the entities you want in HomeKit below; every control is optional.

positions.name: Sliders – adjustable sections
positions.description: The adjustable sections of the bed. Shown as a blinds slider; while moving the Home app shows “opening” or “closing”.

data_description.back: Position of the head section. A position number works best; a cover without position only knows fully open or closed.
data_description.tilt: Tilt or pillow motor, if the bed has one.
data_description.lumbar: Lumbar motor, if the bed has one.

comfort.name: Sliders – massage, light and fan
comfort.description: Massage becomes a blinds slider, light a lamp and fan a fan in the Home app. Levels 0–10 snap to steps of 10 %.

data_description.head_massage: Massage strength at the head, 0 is off.
data_description.foot_massage: Massage strength at the feet, 0 is off.
data_description.wave_massage: Strength of the wave pattern. Only has effect while head or foot massage is running.
data_description.light_level: Bed light, or any HA light such as a Hue lamp next to the bed. Colour and colour temperature appear in HomeKit when the light supports them.
data_description.under_bed_light_level: Under-bed light, or any HA light such as a Hue light strip. Colour and colour temperature appear in HomeKit when the light supports them.
data_description.fan_level: Speed of the bed fan. Turning it on restores the last speed.
data_description.color_light_level: Gives this light a colour wheel and colour temperature in the Home app, if the light supports colour. In the grouped bed tile the Home app then shows a colour button below the slider instead of the caption. Turn off to keep the caption; the light stays dimmable and you choose its colour in the Hue app or Home Assistant.
data_description.color_under_bed_light_level: Gives this light a colour wheel and colour temperature in the Home app, if the light supports colour. In the grouped bed tile the Home app then shows a colour button below the slider instead of the caption. Turn off to keep the caption; the light stays dimmable and you choose its colour in the Hue app or Home Assistant.
data_description.light_level_left: Light for this side of a combined bed, for example a Hue lamp.

switches.name: Switches
switches.description: Buttons, scripts and scenes act as push buttons and fall back to off after one second. Switches and lights show their real state.

data_description.stop: Stops all motors and cancels queued moves.
data_description.memory_1: Moves the bed to memory position 1.
data_description.memory_2: Moves the bed to memory position 2.
data_description.memory_3: Moves the bed to memory position 3.
data_description.memory_4: Moves the bed to memory position 4.
data_description.memory_5: Moves the bed to memory position 5.
data_description.massage_toggle: Switches all massage on or off.
data_description.massage_head_toggle: Switches the head massage on or off.
data_description.massage_foot_toggle: Switches the foot massage on or off.
data_description.light_toggle: Switches the bed light on or off.
data_description.under_bed_light_toggle: Switches the under-bed lighting on or off.

Your bed shows the controls that can be registered in HomeKit. Clear a field to keep that control out of HomeKit.

data_description.enforce_captions: Sends the names back when the Home app assigns names of its own. Turn off to rename controls in the Home app yourself.

data_description.inverted: For controls registered in HomeKit as blinds, swaps the display and the state (open/closed) of the slider. A flat bed or massage off then shows as 100 % / Open, and moving the slider down raises the section. Best for operating with the slider. Because percentages are swapped too, this setting suits Siri and HomeKit scenes less well.

pairing.title: Pair with HomeKit
pairing.description:
Open the Home app, tap **+** → **Add Accessory** and scan this code. Or choose *More options* and enter the setup code **{pin}** by hand.

The bed appears as a bridge with the accessory **{name}**.

paired.title: Already paired
paired.description:
**{name}** is paired with {controllers} HomeKit controller(s), so no setup code can be shown.

Did you remove the bed in the Home app while it was not reachable? Then the Home app has forgotten it, but the bed still thinks it is paired and cannot be added again. Reset the pairing to start over with a new setup code. The bed then appears in the Home app as a new accessory: rooms, scenes and automations have to be set up again.

data.reset: Reset pairing and show a new setup code

data_description.reset: Only do this if the bed is no longer in the Home app.

abort.not_running: The HomeKit accessory is not running. Check the notifications and the log, then try again.

port_error.message: The HomeKit accessory **{name}** could not start on port {port}: {error}. Choose another port (remove and re-add the integration).

memory_not_saved.message: This Jensen bed keeps memory positions in Home Assistant. Put the bed in the wanted position and press *Save to Memory {slot}* (button.*_program_memory_{slot}) of Adjustable Bed once.

memory_one_slot.message: This Jensen box (type 4) has only one memory slot. Remove the other memory switches in the HomeKit Bed options.

reset_pairing.name: Reset HomeKit pairing
reset_pairing.description: Forgets the pairing and shows a new setup code. Remove the old bed from the Home app first.

push_captions.name: Push captions again
push_captions.description: Sends all captions to the Home app again, without pairing again.
